<subject>Reminder -- Last Day to Provide Input on Naming of Meridian Child Care Centre!</subject>
<body>
As Meridian finalizes plans for our child care centre scheduled to open during the 3rd quarter of next year, we are seeking input on 5 alternative names/concepts for the naming of our centre. If you've already given feedback, THANKS!

If you have not, please take 5 minutes of your time to stop by MB 21A7 from 11-1 TODAY to give us your opinion.

Feel free to bring a colleague! FREE biscuits will be provided!

Please forward this email to any other Meridian employees that may want to provide their input on the naming of the centre.

We look forward to seeing you later today!

Regards,

Grace Elliott  
Executive Assistant  
Meridian Law & Advisory LLP  
grace.elliott@meridianlaw.com  
+44 20 7123 4567  
One Fleet Street, London EC4Y 9DS
</body>
